in_marathi.name: Kshitish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshitish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kshitish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'kshiti' meaning 'earth'. The name Kshitish is given to a boy and it signifies the one who rules over the earth. In Hindu mythology, Kshitish is an epithet of Vishnu, the preserver deity.
